# StampDEX documentation

> Public documentation for StampDEX, the marketplace and explorer for Bitcoin
> Stamps and SRC-20 at https://stampdex.fun. Bitcoin mainnet only. Lifecycle:
> stable, continuously deployed. Trades execute at StampDEX rather than inside
> other Bitcoin Universe products.

Two facts shape most of this documentation.

1. An SRC-20 trade routes the buyer payment through escrow addresses StampDEX
   controls until the tokens reach the buyer. A Bitcoin Stamps purchase does not:
   it settles in one Bitcoin transaction through a Counterparty dispenser.
2. Neither protocol supports an in-place listing price update. The ecosystem
   capability registry records update-listing as unsupported for both, because no
   atomic listing update is implemented and listings must be cancelled and
   relisted.

## Home

- [StampDEX documentation](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/): How the StampDEX trading venue for Bitcoin Stamps and SRC-20 works, including the order lifecycle, custody at every step, fees, settlement, and the public read API.

## Start

- [What you can and cannot do](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/capabilities/): The exact list of marketplace actions StampDEX supports for Bitcoin Stamps and SRC-20, with the recorded reason for every action that is not supported.
- [Start here](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/start-here/): Five minutes from first visit to knowing your way around StampDEX, with no wallet needed until you want to trade, and the three things to know before you do.
- [What StampDEX is](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/what-is-stampdex/): What StampDEX does, what it deliberately does not do, why it does not call itself non-custodial, and where it sits in the Bitcoin Universe ecosystem.

## Protocols

- [Bitcoin Stamps](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/bitcoin-stamps/): What a Bitcoin Stamp is, how it is issued as a Counterparty asset, how StampDEX trades one through a dispenser, and which stamp actions are not supported.
- [SRC-20](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/src20/): What SRC-20 is, how a token is deployed and minted, and how the three-transaction listing flow makes a trade work on Bitcoin.

## Guides

- [The market board](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/browse-the-market/): How to read the StampDEX SRC-20 market board: what each column means, why a total names its coverage, and why an unknown value never sorts as a zero.
- [Buy SRC-20](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/buy-src20/): Every step of buying an SRC-20 token on StampDEX, what to check before you sign, and what each thing that can go wrong actually means.
- [Cancel a listing](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/cancel-a-listing/): How to take an SRC-20 listing off the StampDEX book, why cancelling needs your signature, when it is refused, and what happens to the tokens afterwards.
- [Change a listing price](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/change-a-listing-price/): Why StampDEX has no in-place listing edit, what cancel-and-relist costs you, and how to do it for SRC-20 and for a stamp dispenser.
- [Collect Bitcoin Stamps](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/collect-stamps/): How to find, judge, and buy a Bitcoin Stamp on StampDEX through a Counterparty dispenser, and why no StampDEX-controlled address is involved in the purchase.
- [Collection pages](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/collection-pages/): How StampDEX collection pages work, what their market figures mean, and why collection membership is metadata rather than chain state.
- [List and unlist a stamp](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/list-a-stamp/): How to put a Bitcoin Stamp up for sale through a Counterparty dispenser, how to take it down, and why closing has a cooldown.
- [Your portfolio](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/portfolio/): How to see the SRC-20 balances, stamps, open orders, and activity an address holds on StampDEX, with a connected wallet or with no wallet at all.
- [Review a PSBT before signing](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/psbt-review/): What to check in the transaction your wallet shows you before you sign anything on StampDEX, output by output, including the fixed service fee address.
- [Sell SRC-20](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/sell-src20/): How to list an SRC-20 token on StampDEX, what signing a listing commits, what it costs, how to manage it while it is live, and every way it can be refused.
- [Token pages](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/guides/token-pages/): How a StampDEX token page is addressed, what it shows, and the seven states the deployment gate can be in before it will show you a tradeable market.

## Settlement and custody

- [Where your funds are](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/custody/): A stage-by-stage custody map of a StampDEX trade, showing where the asset is, where the buyer's payment is, where the seller's proceeds are, and what a pending or failed settlement actually means.
- [Offers](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/offers/): What the ecosystem registry records about offer support on StampDEX, and why an offers surface existing is not the same as offers being a released way to trade.
- [Order lifecycle](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/order-lifecycle/): The SRC-20 order state machine on StampDEX, every state, every transition, and what each state means for the buyer and the seller.
- [Recovery](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/recovery/): What to do when a StampDEX trade does not complete: a failed order, a stuck transaction, a listing removed from the book, or a settlement undone by a reorg.
- [Settlement lifecycle](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/settlement-lifecycle/): What the StampDEX settlement worker checks before it releases funds, how long it waits, and what it does after a Bitcoin reorg.

## Identity and data

- [Asset identity](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/asset-identity/): Which facts identify an SRC-20 token and a Bitcoin Stamp on StampDEX, so a look-alike cannot ride a real asset's reputation.
- [Data provenance](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/data-provenance/): Which service answers each question on StampDEX, which of them are third parties, what the ecosystem registry records as each source of truth, and how to check it live.
- [Deployment identity](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/deployment-identity/): How StampDEX resolves an SRC-20 ticker to exactly one deployment before it will show you a market, and the four answers it can give.
- [Freshness](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/freshness/): How far behind live a StampDEX number can be, what the status endpoint reports, and what Universe does and does not enforce about lag.
- [Market data](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/market-data/): What each number on StampDEX means, which source answered it, how it is derived, and the guards that stop an absurd figure being repeated.
- [Unknown is not zero](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/concepts/unknown-is-not-zero/): The difference between a source saying nothing and a source saying zero, why StampDEX keeps them apart, and how to read the distinction in the API.

## Reference

- [Capability matrix](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/reference/capability-matrix/): The raw ecosystem registry fields for Bitcoin Stamps and SRC-20 on StampDEX, including surfaces, ownership model, and every unsupported action with its reason.
- [Fees](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/reference/fees/): Every fee StampDEX charges, who pays it, how the network fee is estimated, and a worked example including the case where the minimum dominates.
- [Glossary](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/reference/glossary/): Plain-word meanings for the terms StampDEX uses, from CPID and dispenser to the per-listing escrow addresses and the signature type a listing is signed with.
- [Order states](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/reference/order-states/): Every SRC-20 order state on StampDEX, the value the API returns for it, what it means, where the funds are in it, and what ends it.
- [Wallets](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/reference/wallets/): Which wallets work with StampDEX, exactly which actions each one can perform here, and the per-wallet caveats that matter.

## API

- [Worked examples](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/api/examples/): Complete, runnable examples against the StampDEX public read API, each stating what it does, what to expect back, and how to read the answer honestly.
- [Market endpoints](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/api/market/): SRC-20 market data from the StampDEX API: token lists, price history, trades, fee rates, the deployment resolution routes, and the source map on every row.
- [Media endpoints](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/api/media/): Stamp artwork and token logos from the StampDEX API, their caching behaviour, and the content policy applied to untrusted stamp files.
- [Orders endpoints](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/api/orders/): Reading and creating SRC-20 listings through the StampDEX API, the wallet challenge every mutation needs, and the fields an order returns.
- [API quick start](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/api/quickstart/): The StampDEX public read API: base URL, first request, what needs no key, what needs a wallet signature, and how CORS affects browser callers.
- [Rate limits](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/api/rate-limits/): The StampDEX API request limits, which routes are limited more tightly than the 300 per minute default, which routes are exempt, and how to stay under them.
- [Stamps endpoints](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/api/stamps/): Bitcoin Stamps, collections, dispensers, and wallet holdings from the StampDEX API, including how to tell nothing for sale apart from could not ask.
- [Status and version](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/api/status/): The StampDEX health, version, index freshness, and per-transaction truth endpoints, what every field means, and how to check which commit is serving you.

## Safety and support

- [Frequently asked questions](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/faq/): Short answers to the questions people ask most about StampDEX, from custody and fees to why a listing price cannot be edited, each linking to the full explanation.
- [Safety and trust](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/safety/): What StampDEX can and cannot do with your funds, which claims it refuses to make about itself, and how to check every one of them.
- [Troubleshooting](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/troubleshooting/): The problems people actually hit on StampDEX, what causes each one, and what fixes it, from unknown values and rate limits to a stamp that will not relist.

## Project

- [Changelog](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/project/changelog/): What changed in this documentation and in the StampDEX surfaces it describes, newest first, including corrections to facts previously published here.
- [Contributing](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/project/contributing/): How to correct or improve this documentation, the writing and colour rules it holds itself to, and the grounding rule that keeps claims tied to evidence.
- [Page freshness](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/project/page-freshness/): When each page here was last verified, which product surface it was verified against, and what change should trigger a recheck of it.
- [Release evidence](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/project/release-evidence/): How StampDEX records what has been verified, what its release registry said at the last recorded snapshot, and what that means for anything you are about to trade.

- [资产身份识别机制](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/asset-identity/): 比特币 Stamps 与 SRC-20 代币如何在区块链交易中确立唯一身份。
- [比特币 Stamps 协议原理](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/bitcoin-stamps/): 利用比特币交易输出 (UTXO) 进行永久、不可修剪的数据存储机制详解。
- [资金与资产托管机制](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/custody/): 全方位揭示交易全流程中买卖双方资产的具体存放位置与所有权归属。
- [数据来源与可信溯源](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/data-provenance/): 解释 StampDEX 市场数据如何由比特币全节点与验证索引器共同背书。
- [代币部署与唯一性核验](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/deployment-identity/): SRC-20 代币的部署交易、首发原则与同名冲突解决算法。
- [数据新鲜度与核验周期](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/freshness/): 不同文档页面与市场数据的有效期承诺及过期警示机制。
- [市场数据计算口径](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/market-data/): 底价 (Floor)、24小时成交额、订单深度与价格走势图的统计方法。
- [报价与出价机制 (Offers)](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/offers/): 买家主动出价、资金预冻结与卖家一键接受的撮合逻辑。
- [订单生命周期状态机](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/order-lifecycle/): 从草稿、挂单、等待买家、签署部分签名的比特币交易 (PSBT) 到原子结算的完整十状态流转。
- [异常订单与资产恢复](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/recovery/): 因买家超时、网络重组或广播失败导致的未结订单如何安全取回资产。
- [结算生命周期与原子互换](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/settlement-lifecycle/): 单笔比特币交易完成资产与资金同步互换的技术原理与防违约保障。
- [SRC-20 代币标准详解](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/src20/): 基于 Stamps 协议的同质化代币规范：部署 (Deploy)、铸造 (Mint) 与转账 (Transfer)。
- [未知不等于零 (Unknown Is Not Zero)](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/concepts/unknown-is-not-zero/): 核心数据原则：索引未记录或网络未同步的数据标记为未知，严禁显示为 0。
- [常见问题解答 (FAQ)](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/faq/): 关于 StampDEX 交易机制、资金托管、费用费率与资产安全的常见疑问解答。
- [如何浏览市场行情](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/browse-the-market/): 搜索代币、查看历史成交图表、筛选稀缺 Stamps 与分析订单簿深度。
- [购买 SRC-20 代币指南](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/buy-src20/): 从选定价格、连接钱包、审查部分签名的比特币交易 (PSBT) 到完成支付的全流程。
- [取消挂单操作指引](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/cancel-a-listing/): 在买家撮合前主动撤销上架中的挂单并将资产取回至个人钱包。
- [调整在架商品价格](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/change-a-listing-price/): 一键撤销原挂单并以新价格重新上架资产的组合原子操作。
- [收集比特币 Stamps 指南](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/collect-stamps/): 如何辨识早期古典 Stamps、评估艺术稀缺性并安全完成藏品购买。
- [系列藏品合集页面指南](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/collection-pages/): 探索合集总市值、底价走势、稀有度排行榜与持有人分布。
- [上架出售比特币 Stamp](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/list-a-stamp/): 设定心理价位、授权专用锁定脚本并发布至全局订单簿。
- [个人资产与持仓看板](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/portfolio/): 实时追踪钱包中的 SRC-20 余额、Stamps 艺术藏品与累计投资盈亏。
- [部分签名的比特币交易 (PSBT) 签名审查指引](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/psbt-review/): 逐项核对输入、输出、找零地址与服务费金额的专业防钓鱼教学。
- [出售 SRC-20 代币指南](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/sell-src20/): 将代币挂单至订单簿并坐等买家完成原子结算的全套操作流程。
- [代币专属详情页指南](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/guides/token-pages/): 阅读代币基本面数据、铸造进度、持仓巨鲸分布与实时买卖盘口。
- [更新日志与版本历史](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/project/changelog/): 记录 StampDEX 各版本功能迭代、安全增强与文档演进的发布档案。
- [贡献指南与文档规范](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/project/contributing/): 如何为 StampDEX 技术文档提交 PR、运行质量检查套件与参与双语翻译。
- [页面新鲜度管理策略](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/project/page-freshness/): 阐述文档核验窗口（30天、90天、180天）与技术真理流水线的运作逻辑。
- [生产发布证据与审计记录](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/project/release-evidence/): 线上各微服务与智能合约部署哈希、测试结果与自动化流水线凭证。
- [完整功能能力矩阵](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/reference/capability-matrix/): 各项协议资产操作（买入、卖出、转账、铸造）在不同平台与钱包下的支持详情。
- [完整费用费率标准](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/reference/fees/): SRC-20 交易服务费（买卖双方各 1.5%，最低 500 satoshis）与网络矿工费解析。
- [核心术语与双语词汇表](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/reference/glossary/): 比特币、Stamps、SRC-20 与非托管交易相关的标准专业词汇对照表。
- [订单状态枚举规格](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/reference/order-states/): OrderStatus 完整十状态定义、产生条件、流转方向与前端呈现规范。
- [支持钱包清单与兼容性](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/reference/wallets/): Universe Wallet、UniSat、Leather、Xverse 与 OKX Wallet 的连接与签名支持。
- [安全守则与操作规范](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/safety/): StampDEX 安全最佳实践：私钥防护、签名审查与非托管安全须知。
- [新手快速入门指南](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/start-here/): 五分钟带您了解 StampDEX：无需钱包浏览市场，安全连接钱包并发起交易。
- [故障排查指南](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/troubleshooting/): 常见交易报错、未决交易卡顿、钱包签名超时与订单状态异常排查指引。
- [系统化学习路径](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/tutorials/learning-paths/): 专为新手交易员、资深收藏家、协议开发者与审计人员定制的阶段式学习路径。
- [什么是 StampDEX](https://bitcoinuniverseio.github.io/docs-stampdex/zh-cn/what-is-stampdex/): 面向比特币 Stamps 与 SRC-20 资产的专业交易平台，提供非托管订单撮合与原子结算。
